records.title: FORM 10-K
records.text: In 2023, we reported net earnings of $134, or 0.9% of net sales, $0.82 per diluted share and EBIT of $251, or 1.8% of net sales.

records.title: FORM 10-K
records.text: Adjusted EBIT1 was $567, or 4.0% of net sales, and Adjusted EPS1 was $2.12, which exclude the impacts of charges related to the wind-down of Canadian operations and a supply chain asset impairment and related charge.

records.title: FORM 10-K
records.text: We continued to manage with leaner inventories and exited 2023 with overall ending inventory levels 3% lower than the fourth quarter of 2022 and a positive sales-to-inventory spread.

records.title: FORM 10-K
records.text: Nordstrom net sales and GMV decreased compared with 2022, which reflected a decrease in the number of items sold, partially offset by an increase in the average selling price per item sold.

records.title: FORM 10-K
records.text: Net cash used in financing activities decreased $77 between 2023 and 2022 primarily due to decreased share repurchases in 2023 compared with 2022.
